info.title: AuthOwl Admin API
info.description: Project-scoped server API. The environment is always derived from the secret key. Successful responses identify it through X-AuthOwl-Application-Id, X-AuthOwl-Environment-Id, and X-AuthOwl-Environment-Type headers.

tags.name: Users

tags.description: Canonical streamed user migration validation and writing.

tags.name: Messages

post.summary: Start an ordinary project user export
post.description: Creates a queued CSV or NDJSON export without password hashes. The artifact is generated by the user-export processor and expires after 24 hours.
Requires a dedicated secret key whose only scope is users:export_hashes plus a one-time approval created by a freshly reauthenticated workspace owner.

200.description: Encrypted-at-rest CSV or NDJSON export stream

post.summary: Validate a canonical user import stream without writing users
post.description: The first NDJSON line must be an authowl.user-import.v1 manifest. Every following line must be one canonical user record. Provider-specific exports must be converted by a CLI or dashboard adapter before reaching this endpoint.

Valid rows are written under row-level savepoints. Validation and identity conflicts are retained in the downloadable report. Reusing the same source provider, namespace, and external id updates the same AuthOwl user.

200.description: One NDJSON result per canonical user row

delete.summary: Revoke all sessions for a user

patch.summary: Patch user metadata with optimistic concurrency
Patch server-authored session metadata with optimistic concurrency

post.summary: Invite a user to an organization

post.description: Requires a dedicated secret key whose only scope is messages:send. The provider and credential ownership remain server-side routing concerns.
The signing secret is returned only in this response.
During the returned overlap window, deliveries include signatures from both the new and previous secret.

200.description: New one-time signing secret and old-secret overlap expiry

post.description: Queues one synthetic `webhook.test` event without changing endpoint health, including while the endpoint is paused.

post.summary: Replay an immutable webhook event as a new attempt
post.description: Starts a new delivery cycle with the original immutable event ID so consumers can deduplicate safely.

secretKey.description: Environment-scoped AuthOwl secret key. Development uses sk_test_ and production uses sk_live_. Publishable pk_* keys are rejected.

Forbidden.description: Secret key lacks the required scope

NotFound.description: Resource is missing or belongs to another project

VersionConflict.description: Metadata changed since the supplied version was read

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing resource or idempotency record

ImportValidationFailed.description: The canonical stream envelope, encoding, or hard limits are invalid

MetadataObject.description: JSON metadata object. Reserved prototype keys and the authowl_ prefix are rejected at every depth. Encoded object size is limited to 8192 bytes.
